The '''Battle of RZ7-6113-23''' took place in orbit of [[RZ7-6113-23]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lar Ndigo]] met [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Pallaxides]]. Solo assigned him a [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type Star Cruiser]] to investigate the [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|disappearance]] of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']] soon before.<ref name="ce3.4" />

==Space battle==
When arriving near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[RZ7-6113-23]], Captain Ndigo's ship was engaged by a surface-to-space cannon. Fearing a trap, he ordered the activation of the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] just before the impact. While the surface cannon was reloading, his damaged ship was immediately attacked by old [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] but they were easily repelled by the more modern [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]]. Knowing that his ship was too damaged to resist a another hit, even with the shields at maximum power, Ndigo decided to disable the shields and concentrate all power to the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] so as to attack the planet. The cruiser was able to destroy the surface cannon before it could shoot the ship once again.<ref name="ce3.4" />

==Ground assault==
[[File:Assault_RZ7-6113-23_base.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] assault the [[RZ7-6113-23 base|base]].]]

After the space battle, the New Republic forces landed on the planet and attacked the [[RZ7-6113-23 base|Imperial base]]. The [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] found few resistance and easily eliminated all the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and penetrated the base. However, the New Republic discovered the place was deserted and the base eventually exploded, killing most of the Republic soldiers inside.<ref name="ce3.5" />

==Aftermath==
The New Republic eventually understood that the space battle was just a diversion to cover the evacuation of the base. In fact, [[Ennix Devian]]'s fleet was ready to [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|strike]] the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] at [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]].<ref name="ce3.5" />
